answer: Paired receipts stop bulk fakes. Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and files two key-signed receipts for one job in the atlas. A basalt quarry issues a tally; an auditor replays its log. An opal market stamps the second; a missing or mismatched pair burns the bond. A pair costs 90: 1,000 fakes pay 90,000 for a 40,000 pool, losing 50,000. A rented receipt names its issuer, and both burn; an honest agent pays 90 once, keeps its share.
